Redfish.md should be updated with Links/Chassis, Links/PCIeDevice, and Links/PCIeFunctions.
Done. Added Links/Chassis, Links/PCIeDevice, and Links/PCIeFunctions to the Processor section in `Redfish.md`. Commit message updated accordingly
Done

Distinguish no item found (ec == boost::system::errc::io_error) from other D-Bus errors. For other D-Bus return it should return messages::internalError. See function collection_util::handleCollectionMembers.
Done. `afterGetProcessorChassisLink()` now checks for `ec != boost::system::io_error` and returns `messages::internalError` for other D-Bus errors, consistent with `handleCollectionMembers`.
Done
Add a warning log.
Done. Added `BMCWEB_LOG_WARNING` when the chassis association returns an unexpected number of endpoints.
Done
use sdbusplus::message::object_path operator/.
Done. Using `sdbusplus::message::object_path(object)` now.
Done

Distinguish no item found (ec == boost::system::errc::io_error) from other D-Bus errors. For other D-Bus return it should return messages::internalError. See function collection_util::handleCollectionMembers.
Done. Using the same pattern applied in `afterGerPCIeFunctionsLinks - io_error` is treated as no-item-found.
Done

`nlohmann::json::array_t pcieFunctionList;`
and then after populating pcieFunctionList, sort pcieFunctionList and do,
`asyncResp->res.jsonValue["Links"]["PCIeFunctions"] = std::move(pcieFunctionList);`
Done. Using `nlohmann::json::array_t` now, sorted with `std::ranges::sort` before moving into the response.
Done

Where is the PDI that defines this association. If it doesn't exist update the commit message with link to the PDI patch. Also shouldn't we be using `producing`, since `exposing` is only for PCIeDevice, see - https://github.com/openbmc/phosphor-dbus-interfaces/blob/master/yaml/xyz/openbmc_project/Inventory/Item/PCIeFunction.interface.yaml#L162
use sdbusplus::message::object_path operator/.
The implementation is indeed looking for association between PCIeDevice and PCIeFunction, so I think `exposing` would be better than `producing`.
Done. Using `sdbusplus::message::object_path` and its operator now.
Done
Done

```suggestion
inline void getLinksForAccelerator(
```
Done. Function renamed to `getLinksForAccelerator()`
Done
We should only add this link only if object path that has xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Item.Accelerator also has xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Item.PCIeDevice.

Done. `getLinksForAccelerator()` now takes the `interfaceList` and returns early if `Inventory.Item.PCIeDevice` is not present. `Link/PCIeDevice` and `Links/PCIeFunctions` are only populated when both `Accelerator` and `PCIeDevice` interfaces exist on the object.
Done
Shouldn't this be added regardless of processor type? Can we put it outside of this if else statement?
Done. `getProcessorChassisLink()` is now called outside that if-else block after the service name loop, so it applies to all processor types.
Done
See if you can use collection_util::handleCollectionMembers instead.

Done.
Modified the previous implementation to use `collection_util::handleCollectionMembers`.
Shouldn't we specify Chassis D-Bus interface to constraint the search?

Done.
Added chassis interface to constraint the searching result.
Shouldn't we specify PCIeFunctions D-Bus interface to constraint the search?

Done.
Added PCIeFunction interface to constraint the searching result.
There is a Chassis interface list already defined, please use that.

Done.
Removed the redundant `processorChassisInterfaces` definition and reuse the one defined in `redfish-core/include/utils/chassis_utils.hpp`
for ec other than EBADR we should do internalError.

Done.
Added handler for ec other than EBADR.
Do we really need to populate this properties if the list is empty?

Done.
Removed the redundant assignment for the response.
Is it necessary to create this object and bind it to the callback? Can we create it in the callback?

Done.
Moved the logic into the callback function.
can we add `if (ec.value() == EBADR)` case?

Done.
Added the case for `ec.value() == EBADR`
change to sdbusplus::object_path

Done.
Replace `sdbusplus::message::object_path` with `sdbusplus::object_path`.
change to sdbusplus::object_path
